interpretation.headline: Two-call hybrid split at K56 golden: best 0.9392 s (F=0.20) vs pure-packed4 single-call 0.9545 s — only 1.6% faster. SPLIT-CALL HYBRID REJECTED: cannot reach the 0.772-0.783 s MoE budget.
interpretation.why: Splitting DOUBLES per-layer launches/layout/act-quant/reduce (+48 ms measured overhead). At M~4 both GEMM paths are launch/occupancy-bound, so moving 33% of assignments (top-20% experts by golden frequency) to hot8 saves little; the overhead cancels it.
interpretation.vram_note: F=0.20 partials+p4 = 4.76 GB banks; +core 7.0 = 11.76 GB (marginal). The fits flags reflect all-partials co-residency during the sweep, not per-config steady state.
interpretation.remaining_path: Single-call hybrid: extend the grouped kernel with an expert-SET hot_mask (hot experts read hot8 weights, cold read packed4, one launch, one layout). MXINTHybridBank exists but hot_mask is overwritten by counts>crossover per call (mxint.py:1325) — needs kernel-side expert-set indexing. This is the decisive Track B kernel task for production-fit MoE.
interpretation.gate_status: NEXT 1 gate (MoE <=750-780ms production-fit): NOT MET (0.939 s best). Single-call hybrid or packed4-kernel speedup required.
